_comment: Copy to deployment_config.json (untracked). Keys read by scripts/main_scripts/*.ts: deploy_core.ts reads controllers/discounts/discountToken/tokens/defaultTickSpacings and writes commonContracts; deploy_next_pool.ts reads commonContracts/tokens/swapPools/fee/protocolFeeFraction and fills swapPools[].address; deploy_quoter.ts reads commonContracts.factory + tokens.wvc and writes commonContracts.quoter. Env: VINUSWAP_OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY, VINUSWAP_RPC_URL, VINUSWAP_CONFIRM=<target address|yes>, VINUSWAP_DEPLOYMENTS_DIR, VINUSWAP_DEFAULT_DISCOUNT=tiered, VINUSWAP_POOL_FEE_MANAGER, VINUSWAP_ALLOW_BYTECODE_MISMATCH, COINGECKO_DEMO_API_KEY. protocolFeeFraction: 0 or an integer 4..10 (the pool takes 1/N of swap fees), not a decimal.
